_readme: This file is NOT loaded by the site — nothing fetches or <script>s it. It's a reference for the manual header swap: when releasing a course, take the block for that course and hand-copy each value into the matching spot in index.html / offline.html (the exact line is noted per field). The one live/functional piece of course identity is js/course-config.js (data-course attribute + Supabase keys + storage prefix) — that one you DO have to edit directly, this file just tells you what to paste where.
